name: io.github.k-luecke/paxiom-receipts
title: Paxiom Receipts MCP
description: Verify and explain Ed25519 proof-bound delivery receipts (paxiom.receipt.v0) for x402 APIs, and discover free public Base USDC settlement & preflight reference endpoints.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a paxiom.receipt.v0 cryptographic delivery receipt (schema, Ed25519 signature, signer authorization via expectedIssuerPublicKeys / expectedPayTo, JCS or raw SHA-256 output binding, expiry, and honest settlement/proof trust state). Deterministic and free; automatically trusts the host counter-attestation public key when trustedVerifierPublicKeys is omitted.

tools.name: explain_receipt
tools.description: Verify a paxiom.receipt.v0 receipt and return a concise human/agent-readable trust-state breakdown and next-action guidance.

tools.name: get_x402_verifier_info
tools.description: Return Paxiom Receipt Verifier reference service metadata, published Ed25519 counter-attestation public keys (/.well-known/x402-keys.json), and free rate-limited public endpoints for live on-chain Base USDC settlement verification and pre-payment seller preflight.
